subject: Microglial Synaptic Pruning Keyed to Conserved Complement Gene in Aging Brains
script: From Agewell Brief: Microglial Synaptic Pruning Keyed to Conserved Complement Gene in Aging Brains. Cross-species transcriptomics pinpoint a conserved complement gene driving microglial clearance of functional synapses during non-pathological brain aging.
